title: Swarm Sense
intro.text: Bring every figure to its exit. Everyone only has a few buttons – so shout who should press what!
intro.hint: Look at your phones: your buttons are there.
explain.go: {name} starts with “Go” · otherwise it starts automatically
feat.controls.d: Each button moves one figure in one direction. The buttons are spread across everyone – talk to each other!
feat.exit.d: Every figure has an exit in its color and parks there. When all are home, the level is done.
feat.fog.d: Rooms only show their inside once a figure enters. Doors and exits are visible anyway.
feat.figures.d: Figures can't pass through each other – sometimes one has to step aside.
feat.three.d: Yellow joins. More figures, more crowding!
feat.four.d: Green is here – now it gets really busy.
feat.hold.d: The door is only open while a figure stands on the plate. One has to stand guard so the others get through.
feat.switch.d: Step on it once – the door opens and stays open.
feat.color.d: Only the figure of that color can trigger the plate.
feat.ice.d: On ice, a figure keeps sliding until it bumps into something.
feat.lava.d: Walk into lava and you're back on your start tile.
feat.teleport.d: Always in pairs: in at one, out at the other.
feat.lantern.d: Picking it up reveals all neighboring rooms.
feat.key.d: The figure that picks it up can open one door of its color.
feat.ghost.d: The figure can pass through one wall or closed door.
feat.swap.d: The figure swaps places with the figure of the shown color.
feat.chaos.d: Stepping on it reshuffles all buttons – check your phones right away!
feat.oneway.d: This tile can only be entered in the arrow's direction.
feat.multistart.d: Figures start in different rooms. Free each other!
assign.title: Look at your phones!
won.title: Everyone's home!
lost.title: Time's up!
pick.title: {name} is choosing a level …
end.title: That was Swarm Sense!
phone.none: No buttons right now – cheer the others on!
phone.change: You can change until time runs out.
